scope: artifact-only diagnosis; no production compiler transformation; three matched A/B/A brackets per comparator, not a layout confidence interval

protocol.pmu: inherited user instructions and cycles, FIFO-gated hot window
protocol.jvm: G1, 512 MiB, -Xbatch, no tiered compilation, threshold 100, -Xverify:all; 256 warmups and 128 measured calls

variants.general: i64 product; conversion; floating /2,+i,+1; proved bounded nonnegative loop domain required
variants.guarded: general fast loop under count <= 2^26; original floating fallback preserved
variants.whole: count <= 2^25; integer product,/2,+i,+1 then conversion; requires even-product proof
variants.scaled: count <= 2^25; 2.0 / double(product + 2*i + 2); exact dyadic scaling, no parity precondition
variants.unsigned_half: full-i32 comparator only; logical half of u64 product, preserving the final floating additions; equivalence is for complete A, including signed-zero controls
variants.fasta_integer: i64 affine product/add/remainder; double state holder retained and converted at region ingress; closed [0,139968) state invariant required
